To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new magnetic nanoparticle tracer based on cubic iron oxides with an edge length 22 nm is developed and characterized for its superior magnetic performance and MPI sensitivity.

(1) CIONs with an edge length from 22 to 100 nm were synthesized via a facile one-pot hydrothermal method; (2) CIONs 100 and CIONs 60 exhibit similar saturation magnetization (Ms) but different coercivity, while CIONs 40 and CIONs22 possess similar coercivity but different Ms; (3) CIONs22 show superior MPI performance in terms of sensitivity and spatial resolution compared to the commercial MPI tracer

the cubic shape of iron oxide nanoparticles with a diameter of 22 nm, which are synthesized by a facile hydrothermal approach, exhibit superior magnetic properties for magnetic particle imaging (MPI).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a specialized magnetic particle imaging (MPI)-compatible tracer for stem cell tracking.
the development of a novel type of magnetic nanoparticles for MPI, and its application in stem cell tracking.

developing a specialized MPI tracer with optimized magnetic property and superior cell labeling capability, which is expected to facilitate stem cell therapies by enabling real time and prolonged in vivo tracking.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CIONs 2 2 are superior to the Vivotrax in MPI, and the Vivotrax is superior in MRI.
the engineered CIONs 24 is a promising MPI tracer for stem cell tracking, and the developed strategy for MPI tracer design is of great significance for the future clinical translation of MPI.
the CIONs 2 2 nanoparticles have great potential as a MPI tracer for in vivo cell tracking, and the CIONs are a good model for studying the effects of nanoparticle shape on MPI properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

by controlled engineering of size and shape, we developed a specialized MPI tracer based on cubic iron oxides nanoparticles with an edge length around 22 nm, which exhibit significantly higher MPI performance than the conventional spherical iron oxides nanoparticles.
we have engineered the shape of magnetic nanoparticles to improve their magnetic properties and thus MPI performance.
the CIONs 2 2 are the first MPI tracers with the cubic shape that are developed and tested in vivo.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the shape of magnetic nanoparticles can be engineered to optimize their MPI properties.
the shape of the iron oxide nanoparticle plays a critical role in the performance of MPI tracer, which is a significant advance in MPI tracer development.
, by engineering the magnetic nanoparticle with the optimal size and shape, we have achieved the first MPI tracer that can track stem cells in vivo.
